scope: LSM6DS3TR-C embedded absolute wrist tilt, explicit bounded observation alongside the existing daily pedometer owner

capability_choice.selected: Hardware AWT; no software pose or gesture recognition
capability_choice.owner: Existing product_imu_diag worker and I2C3; no new worker, IRQ or AON
capability_choice.configuration: Require user bank/CTRL1_XL=20h/CTRL10=14h; CTRL10=04h, wait 50ms, CTRL10=00h, bank B=A0h, write/read LAT/THS/Mask, restore bank0, LIR and INT2 route, CTRL10=94h
capability_choice.parameters: 1..120 seconds, one explicit semi-axis (Mask bit7..2), latency1..255 x40ms, threshold20h=500mg=30deg
capability_choice.counter: AN5130 says disabling the pedometer does not reset the counter. AWT code never sets PEDO_RST_STEP or changes ODR/rail; acquisition pauses during preparation. Actual resume continuity and missed steps remain unverified
capability_choice.latched_source: Route to INT2 (official board drawing NC) plus LIR, poll request100ms. Read axes55h before FUNC_SRC2/54h clears the latch. Pair is not atomic; observations are source reads, not gesture counts
capability_choice.cleanup: Wrist-only stop restores CTRL10=14h and saved TAP/PULSE; daily stop clears wrist then stops device. Unconfirmed bank recovery blocks user-register writes. Unconfirmed cleanup retains FAULT/IDLE and invalidates daily data until explicit cleanup/retry
capability_choice.device_effectiveness: Not tested; no evidence that native AWT is inadequate

references.evidence: Section6.1: The step count is not reset to zero when the accelerometer is configured in Power-Down or the pedometer is disabled. Section6.4: custom bankB sequence and routing required for latched FUNC_SRC2; bankB values reset on exit from accelerometer Power-Down
CTRL10 independent PEDO_RST_STEP; FUNC_SRC2 bit0, axes55h and bankB Mask bit7..2. Explicit mask avoids differing default-mask descriptions in AN5130 and datasheet
